call_points.text: Non-MF margin fell to 13% in Q1 from 17%-plus; guided to 16-17% for FY27.
Overall cost increase targeted below 10% for FY27 and the next two to three years.
Alternatives AUM crossed ₹3.2 lakh crore with 50 new mandates won in Q1.
Cash balance about ₹980 Cr at quarter end; board declared ₹2.5 interim dividend.
Management expects residual MF yield compression of 2.5-3% annually, with the telescopic part already in the base.
Cloud, data-centre and hardware costs are rising faster than expected and will partly offset AI savings.
Account aggregator, pension and CAMS Repository are not yet EBITDA positive; CAMSRep expected to turn positive on a final-quarter basis.
Management reiterated target of 20%+ annual growth in non-mutual fund revenue going into FY27.
Management expects employee cost growth to stay under 5% in FY27 supported by flat-to-falling headcount.
Management expects flat KRA overall revenue in FY27, offsetting the ₹8 Cr price reduction via NSE KRA integration (+₹3 Cr) and market share gains (+₹5 Cr).
Total FY26 dividend payout declared stands at ₹305 Cr with a final dividend of ₹4 per share.

operating_notes.text: CAMS unique investor base crossed 4.76 Cr, registering an 18% YoY growth.
CAMS unique investor base crossed 4.76 Cr during Q4FY26, registering an 18% Y-o-Y growth.
Non-MF business revenue grew 25% YoY in Q4 FY26, contributing 15.3% to enterprise revenue.
CAMS KRA took an industry-wide 20% voluntary price reduction effective April 1, 2026.
Women investors reached 13.2 million, accounting for ₹11.3 Tn in AUM and ₹3.0 Tn in gross inflows in FY26.
Q1FY27 AUM about ₹56 lakh crore, up just under 15% YoY, with market share at 67.2%; July AUM came close to ₹60 lakh crore.
SIF segment: 11 unique SIFs live, about ₹12,000 Cr accumulated and almost 50,000 investors, with pricing identical to mutual fund pricing.
Re-architecture project: ₹500 Cr total cost, ₹123 Cr spent, ₹290 Cr capex; ₹40 Cr capitalised in Q1FY27 with another ₹80 Cr expected this year.

watchlist.response: Not answered on the call; management gave only the blended 13% revenue and 16% EBITDA growth figures.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for AUM growth and yield compression assumptions behind the 13% revenue guide; the line dropped and no AUM guidance was given.

watchlist.response: Anuj Kumar said the pricing rules apply equally to all KRAs, but the revenue mix differs: CAMS is 70-75% MF and 25-30% non-MF, while the peer's mix is probably the reverse.
watchlist.text: KRA revenue fell more than peer CDSL after the April price reset; analyst asked why CAMS did not get the same incremental fetch revenue.

watchlist.response: Management said it claims only about 1% annual margin expansion, possibly 1.5%, and expects AMC behaviour to stay constant; rising cloud and hardware costs will partly offset savings.
watchlist.text: Whether AI and automation cost savings can be retained beyond a year, given past AUM-led gains were shared with AMCs.
